Convert a topic-count comparison to a data frame

Source: R/compare.R
as.data.frame.sbert_topic_sweep.Rd

as.data.frame() returns the table of a comparison of candidate numbers of topics as a plain data frame, without the fitted models, for reporting or for joining with other results.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'sbert_topic_sweep'
as.data.frame(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A comparison returned by compare_topics().

...

Ignored.

Value

A base data frame with one row per candidate and columns n_topics, coherence, topic_diversity, explained, and converged, preceded by segment when several levels were compared. The attributes measure and coherence_weight are kept.

See also

compare_topics(); summary().

Examples

corpus <- head(dedupe(feedback_translations, column = "translation"), 600)
comparison <- compare_topics(corpus, n_topics = c(4, 6),
                             column = "translation",
                             embeddings = feedback_embeddings)
as.data.frame(comparison)
#>   n_topics  coherence topic_diversity explained converged
#> 1        4 -0.2070855       0.9250000 0.1229819      TRUE
#> 2        6 -0.1044246       0.9166667 0.2255144      TRUE
